actors.name: Interchange Format Working Group
actors.private_context: The group consists of 21 members who are expected to review and return ballots on draft revision 4. Each member has their own schedule and priorities; some may be more diligent than others.

shared_context: The Interchange Format Working Group has 21 members. Draft revision 4 has been circulated for ballot. The comment period closes at the hard cutoff: 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Ballots are returned individually by members.

starting_events.description: The comment period for draft revision 4 opens. Ballots are due by the close of the comment period.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 14 distinct members of the Interchange Format Working Group (two-thirds of 21) have returned ballots on draft revision 4 before or at 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
